name: Advance Image Mapping
author: Ayush Guleria

sections.description:
Advance Image Mapping is a simple plugin that lets you create interactive image maps. Add clickable points, display tooltips, and use custom or built-in icons. Perfect for product showcases, infographics, and more.

Key Features
* Visual image mapping builder.
* Add unlimited points with tooltips.
* Use default icons or upload your own.
* Embed anywhere with a shortcode.
* Fully responsive and lightweight.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP and activate it.
  2. Go to Image Mapping → Add New.
  3. Upload or select an image in the builder.
  4. Click to add points, set titles, tooltips, and icons.
  5. Insert [advance_image_mapping id="POST_ID"] into any post or page.
sections.faq:
Can I upload my own icons?

Yes, you can upload custom icons for each point.

Is it responsive?

Yes, the image maps work seamlessly on all devices.
